mapper.select: SELECT v.tenant_id AS "versionTenant",v.name,v.description,v.trust_level AS "trustLevel",v.status, v.content_hash AS "contentHash",v.descriptor::text AS "descriptorJson",t.provider_type AS "providerType", t.provider_ref AS "providerRef",t.environment,t.revision AS "deploymentRevision" FROM nw_capability_versions v JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id=v.definition_id AND d.capability_type='TOOL' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.tenant_id JOIN nw_tool_deployments t ON t.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint AND t.deployment_key=#{deployment} AND t.status='ACTIVE' JOIN nw_capability_versions deployed ON deployed.id=t.tool_version_id AND deployed.definition_id=d.id AND deployed.capability_type='TOOL' AND deployed.status='PUBLISHED' AND deployed.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.tenant_id JOIN nw_capability_versions current_version ON current_version.id=d.default_version_id AND current_version.definition_id=d.id AND current_version.status='PUBLISHED' AND current_version.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.tenant_id WHERE v.id=#{version}::bigint AND v.definition_id=#{capability}::bigint AND v.capability_type='TOOL' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND (v.tenant_id IS NULL OR v.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint) AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}

mapper.select: SELECT v.tenant_id AS "versionTenant",v.name,v.description,v.trust_level AS "trustLevel",v.status, v.content_hash AS "contentHash",v.descriptor::text AS "descriptorJson" FROM nw_capability_versions v JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id=v.definition_id AND d.capability_type='SKILL' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.tenant_id WHERE v.id=#{version}::bigint AND v.definition_id=#{capability}::bigint AND v.capability_type='SKILL' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND (v.tenant_id IS NULL OR v.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint) AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}

SELECT v.tenant_id AS "versionTenant",v.name,v.description,v.trust_level AS "trustLevel",v.status, v.content_hash AS "contentHash",v.descriptor::text AS "descriptorJson" FROM nw_capability_versions v JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id=v.definition_id AND d.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.tenant_id WHERE v.id=#{version}::bigint AND v.definition_id=#{capability}::bigint AND v.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND (v.tenant_id IS NULL OR v.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint) AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}

SELECT v.tenant_id AS "versionTenant",v.name,v.description,v.trust_level AS "trustLevel",v.status, v.content_hash AS "contentHash",v.descriptor::text AS "descriptorJson" FROM nw_workflow_instances i JOIN nw_workflow_installation_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.instance_id=i.id AND r.installation_revision=#{installation} JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions installed ON installed.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND installed.id=r.definition_version_id JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions definition ON definition.tenant_id=installed.tenant_id AND definition.container_id=installed.container_id AND definition.id=#{definition} JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.tenant_id=definition.tenant_id AND v.id=definition.capability_version_id AND v.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND d.id=v.definition_id AND d.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint AND i.id=#{instance}::bigint AND i.status='published' AND v.id=#{version}::bigint AND v.definition_id=#{capability}::bigint AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}

SELECT FROM nw_knowledge_base_revisions r JOIN nw_knowledge_bases kb ON kb.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND kb.id=r.kb_id AND kb.status='active' JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.id=r.capability_version_id AND v.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND d.id=v.definition_id AND d.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint AND r.id=#{revision}::bigint AND r.status IN ('published','archived') AND r.published_at IS NOT NULL AND v.id=#{version}::bigint AND d.id=#{capability}::bigint AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}

SELECT FROM nw_knowledge_base_revisions r JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.id=r.capability_version_id AND v.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant}::bigint AND r.id=#{revision}::bigint AND r.published_at IS NOT NULL AND v.id=#{version}::bigint AND v.definition_id=#{capability}::bigint AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')=#{tenant}
